name: Medical cash allowance to dependants

references.title: RR 2-98 s.2.78.1(A)(3) as amended by RR 29-2025 (issued 22 December 2025, in force 6 January 2026) (c): medical cash allowance to dependants to ₱2,000 a semester (₱333 a month): a de minimis benefit to the semester ceiling (January–June, July–December), the excess inside the ₱90,000 exclusion — the DE_MINIMIS_DEPENDANT_MEDICAL checkpoint. The per-month figure is the semester's sixth, so the semester ceiling governs either cadence.

name: Laundry allowance

references.title: RR 2-98 s.2.78.1(A)(3) as amended by RR 29-2025 (issued 22 December 2025, in force 6 January 2026) (g): laundry allowance to ₱400 a month: a de minimis benefit to the ceiling in each calendar month, the excess inside the ₱90,000 exclusion — the DE_MINIMIS_LAUNDRY checkpoint.
